stories.headline: Solar item on Falmouth Town Meeting warrant
stories.dek: Falmouth's Town Meeting is Monday, Oct 26. The warrant (the list of what voters will decide) lists an item on solar.
stories.quote: …capacity shall be included in the calculation of electrical demand, except for on-site solar generation.

brief.what: Same article, flagged twice. Solar comes up only because on-site solar generation is left out when a data center's electrical demand is measured for its tier; this is not a solar project. Article 19, a petition, would add a definition of "Data Center" to the zoning bylaw (section 240-3.2) and sort data centers into tiers by electrical demand (Tier I is the small, local or edge-computing kind). The rest of the article, including what each tier would allow, is in the full warrant.
